[[Exordium]] is a [[Legendary weapon|legendary]] greatsword crafted in the [[Mystic Forge]]. 

== Lore ==
{{Legendary unlock text|Explorers venture into [[the Mists]], and sometimes the Mists venture back. Though far less sentient than the Mist-being [[Razah]], Exordium takes some joy in adapting to its wielder's needs and expectations.}}
{{quotation|[https://www.guildwars2.com/en/the-game/releases/may-14-2019/ Official Website]
|This mysterious blade’s form expresses itself in unique ways based on its wielder’s need, briefly taking on a different shape when thrown, thrusted, stabbed, or slammed into a target.}}
{{quotation|[[Game_updates/2019-05-14#New_Legendary_Weapon:_Exordium|Official update notes]]
|Tyria is on the brink of a new era of magic and technology. Exordium physically embodies this renaissance—a symbol of hope, unity, and a bold way forward. The blade's form expresses itself in unique ways based on the user's specific need, taking on different shapes when thrown, thrust, or slammed into a target.}}

== Graphics ==
Exordium is a vibrant crystal-themed greatsword, representing a renaissance of magic and technology in the world of Tyria. It is the first legendary weapon that changes its appearance while using certain weapon skills. 

;Aura
* Swirls of golden light with floating crystal bits surround the swordsman's arms.

;Draw/Stow Animation
* Upon drawing the weapon, a vortex of gleaming light infused with speckles of gold and shards of crystal erupts from the greatsword and attaches itself to the character's upper limbs.
* When stowing Exordium, the swirls and shards dematerialize into air.

;Footfalls
* The character leaves quickly dissolving vortexes of orange and blue and pieces of light on the ground. Footfalls act as a faint [[light source]] on their own.

;Skill effects
* During melee chain attacks, the blade expands before each strike, reaching its largest form on the third strike of the chain.
* Projectiles thrown while wielding Exordium become large four-pointed stars.
* Exordium changes its shape when used with specific skills: 
** {{g}} [[Guardian]]:
*** {{skill icon|Whirling Wrath}} and {{skill icon|Binding Blade}}: The sword morphs into a double bitted axe.
*** {{skill icon|Binding Blade}} (pull): Large "wings" spread from the sides of the sword guard.
*** {{skill icon|Leap of Faith}}: The sword morphs into a hammer.
*** {{skill icon|Symbol of Resolution}}: Large "wings" spread from the sides of the sword guard.
*** {{skill icon|Spear of Justice}}: Spear transforms into a four pointed star.
*** {{skill icon|Shelter}}: Large "wings" spread from the sides of the sword guard.
** {{m}} [[Mesmer]]
*** {{skill icon|Spatial Surge}}: Rings appear along the length of Exordium, while golden crystals swirl around it.
*** {{skill icon|Mirror Blade}}: The blade splits into a four-pointed star.
*** {{skill icon|Mind Stab}}: Large "wings" spread from the sides of the sword guard.
*** {{skill icon|Phantasmal Berserker}}: Large serrated edges sprout along the one edge of the blade.
*** {{skill icon|Mirror}}: Large "wings" spread from the sides of the sword guard.
*** {{skill icon|Mass Invisibility}}: Large "wings" spread from the sides of the sword guard.
** {{r}} [[Ranger]]
*** {{skill icon|Maul (ranger greatsword skill)}}: Large serrated edges sprout along the one edge of the blade.
*** {{skill icon|Swoop}}: The sword morphs into a hammer.
*** {{skill icon|Counterattack}}: The sword morphs into a shield.
*** {{skill icon|Hilt Bash}}: The pommel extends into a large spike.
*** {{skill icon|"We Heal As One!"}}: Large "wings" spread from the sides of the sword guard.
** {{reaper}} [[Reaper]]
*** {{skill icon|Gravedigger}}: The sword morphs into a scythe.
*** {{skill icon|Death Spiral}}: The sword morphs into a lance.
*** {{skill icon|Nightfall}}: Large serrated edges sprout along the one edge of the blade.
*** {{skill icon|Grasping Darkness}} and {{skill icon|Spectral Grasp}}: The sword morphs into a whip.
** {{vindicator}} [[Vindicator]]
*** {{skill icon|Mist Unleashed}}: Large "wings" spread from the sides of the sword guard.
*** {{skill icon|Phantom's Onslaught}}: Large serrated edges sprout along the one edge of the blade.
*** {{skill icon|Imperial Guard}}: The sword morphs into a shield.
*** {{skill icon|Eternity's Requiem}}: The sword morphs into a scythe.
** {{w}} [[Warrior]]
*** {{skill icon|Hundred Blades}}: Afterimages of the sword appear while swinging it back and forth
*** {{skill icon|Whirlwind Attack}}, and {{skill icon|Arc Divider}}: The sword morphs into a double bitted axe.
*** {{skill icon|Arcing Slice}}: Large serrated edges sprout along the one edge of the blade.
*** {{skill icon|Bladetrail}}: The blade splits into a four-pointed star.

== Trivia ==
* ''Exordium'', the Latin word for "beginning", is used in [[w:Dispositio#Exordium|rhetorics]].
* This weapon has been designed by [[Chelsea Mills]], while [[Vincent Balmori]] and [[Artem Sorokin]] are responsible for its effects, i.e. footfalls, aura and weapon skill animations.<ref name="reddit-chelsea-mills">[https://www.reddit.com/r/Guildwars2/comments/bjzfsu/art_exordium_by_gears2gnomes/eny44er/ Reddit comment by Chelsea Mills]</ref>
** Exordium transforms into 16 different shapes across 19 skill animations.<ref name="reddit-chelsea-mills"/>
* Exordium was released with [[Living World Season 4]] Episode 6, [[War Eternal]].
* Exordium was the last Heart of Thorns legendary weapon and uses the same system of legendary weapon crafting introduced with [[Eureka]].
